description: Google Merchant Center — product catalogue and approval status, item and account issues, and daily free-listing / Shopping-ad performance

mc_products.description: Product snapshot: attributes, price, availability, status; disappeared_at marks products no longer in the feed

mc_product_destinations.description: Approval per product per reporting context (Shopping ads, free listings, ...)

mc_product_issues.description: Item-level issues: code, severity, resolution, attribute

mc_performance_daily.description: Clicks, impressions, conversions per offer per day, split by free listings vs ads

disapproved_products.sql: SELECT p.offer_id, p.title, i.code, i.attribute, i.description FROM mc_product_issues i JOIN mc_products p USING (account_id, product_name) WHERE i.severity = 'DISAPPROVED' AND p.disappeared_at IS NULL

clicks_by_method.description: Last 30 days of clicks, free listings vs Shopping ads
clicks_by_method.sql: SELECT marketing_method, SUM(clicks) AS clicks, SUM(impressions) AS impressions FROM mc_performance_daily WHERE date >= date('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY marketing_method

api_integration.method: Google Merchant API v1 (accounts, products, reports)
